method_note: ADD candidates derived from the live superset (PrimaryRoleId RO197 + RO57 + RO107 for trusts, RO261 name-filtered to "INTEGRATED CARE BOARD" for ICBs) minus DB membership, then filtered by Date[Legal].End. REMOVE candidates come from a FULL Legal-End sweep of all 243 DB members, not just the /sync change feed: the feed only surfaces orgs whose ODS record changed since last_ods_sync_date, so an org that died months ago and has not been touched since is invisible to it (R1C, legal end 2024-09-30, is the standing example). The plain set-difference misses them too because a merged org keeps Status "Active". This run also ran the change feed (1,162 orgs changed since 2026-08-15, 0 of them in-DB deaths) as a cross-check; the full sweep is the authoritative list. All 243 detail lookups succeeded.
